items.title: Why are some galaxies more lopsided than others? A catalog offers clues to the imbalance
items.summary: Some spiral galaxies look heavier or more elongated on one side than the other. Why galaxies get lopsided is not fully understood. It could be due to collisions or gravitational tugs, uneven gas infall, or instabilities within the disk that drag the gas and stars off-center. In a new study, astronomers combined measurements of galaxies from 37 studies to create a big catalog and analyzed it to check for lopsidedness and its cause. The paper was posted to the arXiv preprint server on Nov. 10.

items.title: America's religious "nones" move from voters to lawmakers
items.summary: America's religious "nones" have gained a visible foothold in Congress: Five lawmakers will claim no religious affiliation in January, up from a single member just two years ago. The proposed Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Bill will also include capping ground rent at £250. The government is to introduce new laws to scrap the way flats are built in England and Wales. Under the proposed bill, most new leasehold flats will be banned and replaced with commonhold, where residents collectively own and manage their buildings. Matthew Pennycook, the housing minister, said the current leasehold system was "blighting lives" and was an "anachronism in the twenty-first century". The legislation follows Labour's 2024 election manifesto to "bring the feudal leasehold system to an end" - with further details expected to be set out later.

When the Vikings and 49ers face off in Mexico City on Sunday night, they'll be playing at the highest elevation any NFL game is ever played at: Estadio Azteca's altitude is around 7,300 feet. Kickers and physicists alike have agreed that high altitudes can easily add five yards or more to field goal range. The air is thinner at altitude, and in Mexico City the altitude makes the air about 20 percent less dense than at sea level. In Denver, which is about 2,000 feet lower than Mexico City, the air is about 15 percent less dense than at sea level, and Denver's Mile High Stadium is well known for the boost it gives to kickers.

PGA Tour coach Stephen Sweeney corrects a golfer's putting stroke using two specific setup adjustments, a fix detailed in a new Yahoo Sports report. The golfer in the story arrived at the lesson expecting work on the stroke mechanics. Instead, Sweeney identified a fundamental flaw in the stance. "Where your eyes are right now, I tend to see if players' eyes are inside the ball line; they tend to look out to the right," Sweeney said. This misalignment caused the putter to move slightly on the inside on the backswing, even though it felt square to the player. The result was a subconscious aim to the right of the hole and a stroke path that moved from in to out.

MLB seeks to redistribute player compensation within the league. While the union and league battle over the future of baseball's economics and are barreling toward a management lockout, a lesser-known element also lies at the heart of MLB's vision of the future. Team owners want to change the current separation between player compensation and their on-field value. According to MLB research presented this week to reporters, players with six years or fewer of major league service and not eligible for free agency delivered 71% of the league's total on-field value, as measured by wins over replacement (WAR). That group, however, received just 31% of the total compensation.

An Orange County legal court puts Fens on the basketball court, for now. Today's hearing in front of Judge Alyson Grine sought a Temporary Restraining Order (TRO), a legal mechanism now familiar to most college sports fans. A TRO grants one party in a lawsuit temporary relief while a legal argument proceeds in court. The basic idea is that a party suffering harm while the lawsuit unfolds cannot recover that harm even if he or she wins their case. In other words, Fens' lawyers today argued that Fens' suit has enough merit to be successful but that missing games now irreparably harms him. Those games can't be given back if he wins his suit in a few months.

Cumin-laced sodas are capturing a bigger market share in India as demand for homegrown flavours goes up. Currently, CTE can only be detected after someone has died. As of now, CTE can be diagnosed only after death , through direct study and dissection of the brain. However, two studies published this week in the Journal of the American Medical Association (JAMA) both point to the possibility of detecting CTE through blood tests. The first study was published by a research group with the Washington University School of Medicine on Nov. 13; the second , from researchers at Boston University and Banner Health, was published Thursday. Right now one team, Stanford, is exceeding expectations. The other, Cal, is decidedly not. This is not what many would have predicted last summer when Stanford was picked to finish last in the ACC preseason media poll and Cal was riding high with a well-regarded transferportal class (ranked 14th), a marquee quarterback, and a new coach who had alumni excited.

After a 19-24 season last year, Lake Creek is 43-10 and in its first state final. Coach Kayli Kane says her players expect to win. Winning a state championship in November is vastly more difficult. But yet, at the end of a grueling four-month season, the Lake Creek volleyball team is on the precipice of achieving its primary aspiration. The Lions (43-10) play Abilene Wylie (39-4) for the UIL Class 5A Division II state championship at 11 a.m. Saturday at the Curtis Culwell Center in Garland. Lake Creek reached the state semifinals in 2022 but came up short. Now the Lions have another chance to secure the program's first title.

The brothers grew up playing soccer in Houston. Now they're making history in their own way. Miguel Arana calmly jogged onto the field to get the job done, almost like he'd done it before. From 46 yards, Arana booted the ball through the uprights with nearly 10 yards to spare, giving Texas Southern a walk-off victory on homecoming night inside Reliant Stadium. After the kick, Arana celebrated with teammates as they ran toward the end zone. Once there, he hit Cristiano Ronaldo's signature "Siuuu" celebration, leaping into the air and spinning 180 degrees, landing with his feet apart while throwing his arms down and back before his teammates mobbed him for more celebration.

Christian McCaffrey received the NFL's 2025 Salute to Service Award. This week the 49ers are training at the Air Force Academy, near his hometown where his passion began to take root. In the aftermath, however, Flanery, 40, an Army veteran who attempted suicide in 2012, swallowing a fistful of his anti-depressant and pain pills while recovering from a cascade of traumatic injuries, felt conflicting emotions. The Dragons (27-11) beat Austin High last season in the state finals and this year took down Mansfield to reach the final game. The 2026 6A DII state title match is set for 4 p.m. Saturday at the Curtis Culwell Center in Garland. The game can be streamed on the NFHS network website .

Croix Bethune is only three years into her NWSL career, but each of those seasons have ended in the NWSL Championship. Bethune helped punch the Current's ticket to the league's championship game with a direct free kick in the club's 2-1 semifinal win over Gotham FC. She was also named the NWSL Midfielder of the Year, for the second time in three years, after having first won the honor as a member of the Washington Spirit, the very team she'll face in the NWSL Championship. It's a career trajectory Bethune could only have dreamed of when she was a little girl.

Colton Herta could remain with the Cadillac Formula 1 team as a reserve driver in 2027. The American, disappointed at missing out on a full-time seat with the team, is considering the offer. Dan Towriss, CEO of Cadillac Formula 1 and TWG Motorsports, confirmed in Las Vegas to, among others, GPblog that several options are on the table for Herta. "We have offered him a reserve driver role," the American said first. In that role, the former IndyCar driver could potentially progress to become a full-time Cadillac driver in Formula 1. "The seat for 2028 is still available, so there are several possibilities for Colton. There are options in other racing series too," Towriss continued.

With zero drops and recent production, Malachi Fields is emerging as a reliable third option for the New York Giants' offense.
